digest.component_or_area: plan clarity enforcement and P1 readiness gates
propositions: Empty parsed Acceptance Criteria checkbox items (whitespace-only joined body) must be rejected by standalone clarity and P1 readiness gates
Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in exact active execution sections must be detected and blocked unless suppressed by same-line negation terms
Sentinel matching must be context-aware: triggered only when starting a line, after bullets, following colons/equals, or after specific trigger words; must ignore fenced and inline code
Same-line negation or removal terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without) suppress sentinel matches on their line

Shared plan-structure parser must be implemented as pure helper and wired into both standalone clarity_check_compute and plan-review p1_readiness_shape without changing ticket-type exemptions or legacy compatibility scores
Deterministic floor enforcement must pass all focused unit tests, direct-consumer regression tests, and full repository test suite without source changes to existing test files
